title: Cofinality is invariant under coherent natural equivalence
statement:
Use quasicategories, internal functor categories, coherent natural equivalences, weak contractibility and degreewise simplicial pullbacks of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones]. Let $A,B$ be quasicategories in a fixed universe, and let $u,v:A\to B$ be functors joined by a coherent natural equivalence, meaning an equivalence edge of $\operatorname{Fun}(A,B)$. For a vertex $b\in B$ and a functor $w:A\to B$, define the exact arrow-comma simplicial set
$$M_b(w)=\{b\}\times_{B,\operatorname{ev}_0}\operatorname{Fun}(\Delta^1,B)\times_{\operatorname{ev}_1,B,w}A.$$
Then $M_b(u)$ is weakly contractible for every $b\in B$ if and only if $M_b(v)$ is weakly contractible for every $b\in B$. The universe may be any one containing $A,B$ and the natural-equivalence data; neither category is required to be small in a previously fixed smaller universe.
